Class GymCenter

java.lang.Object
com.flipfit.bean.GymCenter
public class GymCenter extends Object
The Class GymCenter. This class represents a gym center in the FlipFit system. A gym center is owned by a gym owner and must be approved by an admin before customers can book slots. It contains details such as location, capacity, and approval status.
